meta.title: Six-line I Ching reading
meta.description: Cast and read I Ching by the six-line (Liu Yao) method: coin or yarrow casting, automatic chart assembly (palace, world/response lines, stems-branches, six-relatives, six-spirits, hidden lines, void branches, month/day influences, moving-line transformations), verdict from the useful god's strength, timing, practical guidance, and the classical Zhouyi text with a plain-language conclusion. Open it from the sidebar item "Six-line I Ching reading", or ask me to cast and read with liuyao_cast / liuyao_analyze.
